messages:
sofia: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A about release handoffs, SLAs, and oncall changes. Two asks: where will the canonical handoff checklist live, and how strict should SLO gates be for Dedicated rollouts?

devon: Put checklist in engops/release-handoff.md, I'll PR it. For Dedicated rollouts we should tighten gates.

ajay: Proposal: Hosted: 24h canary, Dedicated: 72h canary. Gate if error budget > 1.25x baseline for 20m or p99 latency > 1.5x baseline for 15m.

maria: Also require correctness evals >= 99% before promotion for Dedicated.

kevin: Ops ask: add an automated smoke run post-deploy that checks p99 and a small perf histogram; fail the rollout if smoke fails.

devon: Agreed. We'll add smoke to CI and a checklist item.

sofia: Oncall routing: do we need separate rotas for Dedicated customers?

ajay: No separate rota. Keep single oncall but add Dedicated tag routing so primary can page SME faster.

oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall sync tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Rotation change scheduled 2025-03-01 09:00 UTC.

maria: Action items: devon PR checklist, ajay draft SLO decision matrix, kevin add smoke job, sofia publish summary to #all-hands.

sofia: Thanks — please post PRs in this thread and I'll collect links.
